title: Financing Structural Record
description: Structural Financing graph node. Instrument type, amounts, rates, dates, currencies, and counterparties belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Financing graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Financing contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary instrument name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label; never a sourced financing title.

company_id.description: Structural edge to the financed Company node.

campus_id.description: Optional structural edge to a financed Campus node; null when not applicable.

project_id.description: Optional structural edge to a financed Project node; null when not applicable.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not repayment or instrument status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted financial facts.
